consumer: The frontend tile renderer, asking 'should this tile be drawn with the dimmed remembered-but-not-currently-visible shading?' which it derives from the per-tile player-visibility value the snapshot exports.
scope: The map region of tiles around the avatar within the export radius (the snapshotted nearby tiles).
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (seen) — its body writes json.member("seen", ctx.m.pl_sees(p, ctx.radius)) per tile, emitting the player-can-currently-see verdict the GUI uses to pick visible vs dimmed/remembered shading.
divergence: A tile the avatar explored earlier but currently cannot see (out of LOS, e.g. behind a wall): correct output shades it dimmed (remembered, not visible); a wrong answer that used bare map::sees reachability or reported it as currently seen would render it as fully visible instead of remembered-dim.
